definitions.explanation: A critical evaluation or commentary on a book, typically published in a newspaper, magazine, or academic journal.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}の{書評|しょひょう}を{読|よ}んで{興味|きょうみ}を{持|も}った。
examples.english: I became interested after reading the book review in the newspaper.

examples.japanese: {書評|しょひょう}を{書|か}くのは{本|ほん}を{読|よ}むのとは{違|ちが}う{難|むずか}しさがある。
examples.english: Writing a book review involves a different kind of difficulty from reading a book.

examples.japanese: あの{作家|さっか}の{新作|しんさく}は{書評|しょひょう}で{高|たか}い{評価|ひょうか}を{受|う}け、{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}きも{好調|こうちょう}だ。
examples.english: That author's new work received high praise in reviews and is selling well.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard literary and publishing term. Major Japanese newspapers have dedicated {書評|しょひょう} sections, usually published weekly. Also common in academic contexts for scholarly book reviews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書評|しょひょう}を{書|か}く: to write a book review
- {書評|しょひょう}{欄|らん}: book review column/section
- {書評|しょひょう}{家|か}: book reviewer, book critic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- レビュー: review (loanword, used for books, products, etc.)
- {批評|ひひょう}: criticism, critique (broader, not limited to books)
- {感想|かんそう}{文|ぶん}: personal impressions/essay (less formal, subjective)
